title: FlexAttention: A Programming Model for Generating Optimized Attention Kernels
problem: Every attention variant (causal, sliding window, document masking, ALiBi, paged, etc.) requires a bespoke hand-written CUDA/Triton kernel, creating an O(variants x hardware) maintenance burden and blocking rapid research iteration.
motivation: FlashAttention-2 is fast but rigid. Researchers building new attention variants fall back to slow PyTorch SDPA or write custom kernels. A compiler-driven approach that generates near-FAv2 kernels from high-level specifications would unify the attention ecosystem.
method: Users express attention variants via two Python callables: score_mod (modifies attention logits, e.g., ALiBi bias) and mask_mod (defines which token pairs to attend to). A BlockMask data structure precomputes block-level sparsity from mask_mod, enabling block-sparse FlashAttention. torch.compile lowers score_mod and mask_mod into a Triton kernel template, fusing them into a single tiled GEMM+softmax+GEMM pass. Tile-level masking avoids computing fully-masked blocks.
key_novelty: BlockMask + score_mod/mask_mod composable API that reduces any attention variant to a Triton template instantiation, achieving near-FlashAttention-2 performance for standard variants and large gains for unsupported variants, with <1% overhead for paged attention vs. 20-26% in vLLM.
contributions: score_mod callable API for per-element logit modification
mask_mod callable API for sparsity pattern specification
BlockMask data structure for precomputed block-level sparsity
Triton template-based kernel generation via torch.compile
5.49-8x vs PyTorch SDPA for previously unsupported variants
2.04x gpt-fast inference speedup; 2.4x torchtune training speedup
<1% overhead for paged attention (vs 20-26% in vLLM)

metrics.speedup: 0.68-1.43x vs FAv2 (standard); 5.49-8x vs SDPA (unsupported variants); 2.04x inference; 2.4x training
metrics.other: <1% paged attention overhead vs 20-26% in vLLM; evaluated on H100 and A100

limitations: score_mod and mask_mod must be expressible as element-wise Python functions
Performance varies with sparsity pattern regularity (irregular patterns less efficient)
Compilation time adds latency for novel variants
